Post Date / Update : 03 September 2026 | 04:51 PM
Short Information

Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the Uttar Pradesh Special Teacher Eligibility Test UP Special TET 2026 Can Read the Notification. Those Candidates are Interested to the Following Exam Can Apply Online from 05/09/2026 to 04/10/2026 .candidates should read the UP Special TET 2026 information brochure for all the information related to the UPTET exam like syllabus, eligibility, age limit, fees, Primary and Junior Level, information and other types of information and then apply.

Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC)

Uttar Pradesh Special Teacher Eligibility Test (UP Special TET 2026) Primary and Junior Level

UP Special TET 2026 Advt. No 03/UPTET/2026 | Short Details of Notification

Important Dates

  • Application Begin : 05/09/2026
  • Last Date for Registration : 04/10/2026
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date :04/10/2026
  • Last Date Correction :08/10/2026
  • Exam Date :03/11/2026
  • Exam City Available : Before Exam
  • Admit Card Available :Before Exam
  • Answer Key Available : As Per Schedule
  • Result Declared :As Per Schedule 

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: 1000/-
  • SC / ST : 500/-
  • PH (Divyang) : 300/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through SBI I Collect Fee Mode Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking or Pay the Exam Through SBI E Challan Fee Mode, Submit Fee Any Branches of SBI

UP Special Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 : Age Limit as on 03/11/2026

  • Maximum Age : 60 Years. 

UP Special TET 2026 Primary I to V & Junior VI to VIII Eligibility

UP Special TET Primary Level Eligibility
  • All such schools which are run by the State Government of Uttar Pradesh.
    Special Educator Primary Star Class 01 to 05
  • More Eligibility Details Read the Notification

UP Special TET Junior Level Eligibility
  • All such schools which are run by the State Government of Uttar Pradesh.
    Special Educator Primary Star Class 06 to 08
  • More Eligibility Details Read the Notification
  • Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC), Prayagraj Are Released Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test UP Special TET Examination 2026. Candidate Can Apply Between 05/09/2026 to 04/10/2026.
  • Candidate Read the Notification Before Apply the Recruitment Application Form in UP Special TET Primary and Junior Level 2026.
  • Kindly Check and Collect the All Document – Eligibility, ID Proof, Address Details, Basic Details.
  • Kindly Ready Scan Document Related to Recruitment Form – Photo, Sign, ID Proof, Etc.
  • Before Submit the Application Form Must Check the Preview and All Column Carefully.
  • If Candidate Required to Paying the Application Fee Must Submit. If You have Not the Required Application Fees Your Form is Not Completed.
  • Take A Print Out of Final Submitted Form.
  • For the latest updates on Sarkari Result, admit card, answer key, and result, always visit SarkariResult.com, the official website for Sarkari Result in India (Since 2012).

Frequently Asked Questions

  • The online application process started on 05 September 2026.
Q2.What is the Exam Date for UP Special TET 2026 ?
  • The Exam Date will be Held on in 03/11/2026.
Q3. Where can I find the Selection Procedure for the UP Special TET 2026?
  • The detailed Selection Procedure are available in the official notification. Candidates are advised to read the notification carefully for complete details.

  • Candidates can download the notification through SarkariResult.com.
Q5. What is the last date to apply online for UP Special TET 2026?
  • The last date to apply online is 04 October 2026.
Q6. What is the last date to pay the application fee?
  • Candidates can pay the application fee up to 04 October 2026.
Q7. How can I apply for UP Special TET Online Form 2026 ?
